info.title: IndAI Review-4 Paper Trading API
info.description: NestJS modular backend with signed JWT authentication, refresh-token rotation, role-based access control, DTO validation, Razorpay and minute-stock data endpoints.

JWT.description: Paste the access token returned by POST /api/auth/login.

password.description: Required. Min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, and one of !@#$%^&*.

confirmPassword.description: Optional compatibility field used by frontend/Swagger. If provided, it must match password.

phone.description: Optional but if provided must be 10 digits starting with 6/7/8/9.

dateOfBirth.description: Required by registration frontend. Learner must be at least 10 years old.

yearsOfExperience.description: Compatibility alias for yearsExp used by some Swagger/frontend payloads.

authCode.description: Required for public User Admin / Payment Admin registration requests.

adminTeam.description: Requested/assigned admin division. Public admin requests remain pending until Super Admin approval.

providerVerified.description: Course Provider verification flag. Super Admin sets this after verification.

email.description: Required. Frontend allows Gmail or email ending with .in only.

role.description: Optional selected role from frontend login/register.

quotedPrice.description: Provider quoted amount for course production/licensing.

dueDate.description: Must be a future date within 365 days.

date.description: Must be a future date within 365 days.

questions.description: Frontend may send a question count number; API may also accept question objects.

note.example: Includes 12 modules, videos, PDFs and assessments.

month.description: Billing month in YYYY-MM. Defaults to the current month.

reason.example: Excellent learner skill-point growth this month.

amount.description: Final annual license amount agreed by the institution and Payment Admin.
Final annual license amount agreed by the institution and Payment Admin.
